name: cs-pre-production
description: Runs the studio's pre-production pipeline end to end: a client folder, local or on Google Drive, becomes a project, an orchestrator walks the pre-production stage table spawning ten director agents that wrap the client's skills, every XX item waits on a human, three gates (A Creative sign-off, B Logistics sign-off, C Release to shoot) are decided on the Pre-production board, and the release package is the concept breakdown plus one call sheet per shoot day in the client's templates.
